title: Utility watchdogs accuse PGE of skirting new law meant to make data centers pay for rising demand
summary: Oregon's largest electrical utility, Portland General Electric (PGE), is accused by utility watchdogs of attempting to circumvent a new law, the POWER Act, which mandates that data centers bear the costs of their growing energy demands.
